gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: For the 2018 financial year, Axis Syndicate 1686 reported a net release of USD 18.3 million in outstanding claims relating to the 2017 and prior years of account. This favorable development represents a 4.5% release against the opening gross claims outstanding of USD 406.4 million. The report does not specify particular events or causes for this prior year release, but generally attributes the 2018 loss to high frequency catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Michael and Florence and California Wildfires.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of USD 406.408m. During 2018 there was a net release on prior years of USD 18.3m (a ~4.5% release relative to opening gross claims), driven by favourable development on prior years' claims. The 2018 result was nevertheless a loss largely driven by a high frequency of catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Michael and Florence and California wildfires) affecting property and marine lines. Prior years referenced include 2017 and earlier years (including 2016, 2015 and 2014 where cash calls were made to fund losses).

This primarily resulted from the high frequency of catastrophe events experienced in the year, specifically hurricanes Michael and Florence as well as another year of devastating California Wildfires but also an increase in frequency of large individual losses.
